name: caissa
description: Browser-first, local-first, human-centered AI chess application foundation.

scripts.build: corepack pnpm --filter @caissa/chess-core build && corepack pnpm --filter @caissa/shared-contracts build && corepack pnpm --filter @caissa/web build
scripts.lint: corepack pnpm lint:ts && corepack pnpm lint:python
scripts.lint:python: uv run --frozen --project apps/maia-service ruff check apps/maia-service
scripts.format: prettier --write "apps/web/**/*.{ts,tsx,css,html,json,md}" "apps/maia-service/*.{json,md}" "packages/**/*.{ts,tsx,css,json,md}" "scripts/**/*.{mjs,md}" "tooling/**/*.md" "LICENSES/**/*.md" ".github/**/*.yml" "*.{js,cjs,ts,json,yaml,yml,md}" && uv run --frozen --project apps/maia-service ruff format apps/maia-service
scripts.format:check: prettier --check "apps/web/**/*.{ts,tsx,css,html,json,md}" "apps/maia-service/*.{json,md}" "packages/**/*.{ts,tsx,css,json,md}" "scripts/**/*.{mjs,md}" "tooling/**/*.md" "LICENSES/**/*.md" ".github/**/*.yml" "*.{js,cjs,ts,json,yaml,yml,md}" && uv run --frozen --project apps/maia-service ruff format --check apps/maia-service
scripts.typecheck:ts: corepack pnpm --filter @caissa/chess-core typecheck && corepack pnpm --filter @caissa/shared-contracts typecheck && corepack pnpm --filter @caissa/web typecheck
scripts.test: corepack pnpm test:ts && corepack pnpm test:python
scripts.test:ts: corepack pnpm --filter @caissa/chess-core test && corepack pnpm exec vitest run packages/shared-contracts/src/health.test.ts --coverage.enabled=false && corepack pnpm --filter @caissa/web test:coverage
scripts.architecture:check: node scripts/check-architecture.mjs && depcruise --config .dependency-cruiser.cjs apps/web/src packages/chess-core/src packages/shared-contracts/src
scripts.licenses:check: license-checker-rseidelsohn --start apps/web --production --onlyAllow "0BSD;MIT;Apache-2.0;BSD-2-Clause;BSD-3-Clause;ISC" --excludePackages "@caissa/web@0.1.0;@caissa/chess-core@0.1.0;@caissa/design-tokens@0.1.0" --summary && license-checker-rseidelsohn --start packages/shared-contracts --production --onlyAllow "0BSD;MIT;Apache-2.0;BSD-2-Clause;BSD-3-Clause;ISC" --excludePackages "@caissa/shared-contracts@0.1.0" --summary && license-checker-rseidelsohn --start packages/chess-core --production --onlyAllow "0BSD;MIT;Apache-2.0;BSD-2-Clause;BSD-3-Clause;ISC" --excludePackages "@caissa/chess-core@0.1.0" --summary
scripts.verify:python: uv run --frozen --project apps/maia-service ruff check apps/maia-service && uv run --frozen --project apps/maia-service ruff format --check apps/maia-service && uv run --frozen --project apps/maia-service pytest apps/maia-service
scripts.verify: corepack pnpm format:check && corepack pnpm lint && corepack pnpm typecheck && corepack pnpm test && corepack pnpm architecture:check && corepack pnpm scan:secrets && corepack pnpm artifacts:check && corepack pnpm engine:check && corepack pnpm licenses:check && corepack pnpm build
